info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Warehouse Inventory Locations-v4-spec
info.description: The List Warehouse Inventory Locations API provides a comprehensive overview of available inventory locations within the warehouse. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a detailed list of location identifiers, descriptions, and statuses, aiding in efficient inventory management and operational planning. Typical consumers of this API include warehouse managers and logistics coordinators who require accurate location data for tracking and organizing stock. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their inventory visibility and streamline their supply chain processes.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific inventory location, providing relevant information necessary for inventory management and logistics.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the location details from the inventory. This should include necessary filters or parameters that define which location's details are requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the inventory location data.
